descriptionMarkdown:
Blank / Null-Bound is a GM-permission discipline. It 
represents a sanctioned blank, null-scarred operative, or 
anti-psyker weapon rather than a conventional Warp-
channelling psyker.
Blank / Null-Bound characters may learn Universal and 
Null powers, cannot learn Malefic
powers, and should be rare in the same way as Aeldari 
player characters.
When a Psyker chooses a Psychic Discipline, that choice 
determines which non-universal powers they
can learn. A Psyker may always learn Universal powers. 
They may only learn discipline-locked powers
from their chosen discipline unless the GM grants an 
exception through a relic, corruption event,
mentor, sanctioning scar, or major campaign reward.
